method: ABBA process order per platform, five trials of 100 excerpts per case per process. Identical 350-code-point excerpt policy on ASCII/multilingual inputs, lead/found/missing queries, ~4KiB/~64KiB. Input creation and output equality checks excluded. Every output digest matches. C++ requested allocation bytes include freed buffers, exclude direct C malloc, and are not peak RAM. Shared workstation; no network/browser/model timing.
